movelist.name: Baton Pass
movelist.effect: The user is replaced with another Pokémon from their trainer’s roster. All Combat Stage, Coats, and [Stratagems] on Baton Pass’ user are transferred to the replacement. Baton Pass may be used to switch even if the user is Trapped.

movelist.name: Safeguard
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Safeguard may activate it when receiving a Status Affliction to ignore the effects of that Status Affliction on their next turn. Safeguard may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Reflect
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Reflect may activate it when receiving Physical Damage to resist the Damage one step. Reflect may be activated 2 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Light Screen
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Light Screen may activate it when receiving Special Damage to resist the Damage one step. Light Screen may be activated 2 times, and then disappears.

abilities.name: Huge Power
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Base Attack stat is doubled. This may double any bonuses from Nature or Vitamins, but not bonuses from Trainer Features.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.effect: The user gains a bonus to Initiative equal to half its Speed, and a +3 Bonus on Save Checks against Sleep.
